tei:div.tei:p: na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng du// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// dpal ldan bla ma 'od dpag med// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*// bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams na// gzugs kyi phung po gnas dag pa'i// rnam par snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' rnam dag phag mo yum// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na// rnam shes phung po gnas dag pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs// sa khams rnam dag spyan ma yum// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams na// tshor ba'i phung po gnas dag pa'i// rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs// chu khams rnam dag mā ki yum// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// 'du shes phung po gnas dag pa'i// snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs// me khams rnam dag gos dkar yum// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams na// 'du byed phung po gnas dag pa'i// don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs// rlung khams rnam dag sgrol ma yum// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= mi 'gyur thugs kyi gzhal yas na// zhi ba'i las rnams sgrub mdzad ma// rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// dkar mo 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhal yas na// rgyas pa'i las rnams sgrub mdzad ma// rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// ser mo 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= pad+ma gsung gi gzhal yas na// dbang gi las rnams sgrub mdzad ma// pad+ma rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// dmar mo 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so=

phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= phrin las grub pa'i gzhal yas na// drag po'i las rnams sgrub mdzad ma// las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki ma// ljang mo 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= dam tshig gnyan po'i gzhal yas na// ma mgon lcam dral mthu stobs can// dam can srung ma'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so= phyi nang bar chad= bsam pa 'grub par= bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma dam can tshogs// lhag par thugs rje'i dpung bskyed la// phyi yi bar chad phyi ru gsol// nang gi bar chad nang du gsol// sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*// bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha dgu'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub ma bya ba 'di ni phyi nang gi bar chad mang po brtsam dus gsol ba 'di ltar btab pas bar chad zhi ba'i ltas cung zad byung nas lha 'di nyid la mos pa a rā gas bris pa shubhaṃ ma stu/// /maṅga laṃ/// /
